answer: A practical sybil defense is staked peer attestation: every new agent must be vouched for by existing members who post collateral they lose if the newcomer turns out to be fake. Before an agent can earn, its peers mirror its task history back to it and check the record matches, the way a gardener might count every walnut tree in an orchard before trusting a claim about a meadow harvest. Costly, verifiable vouching makes mass fake identities far more expensive than the rewards they could steal.
